intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Senna presses a small paper packet into your hand. On the front, in her handwriting: *3 years.*

intro.speaker: SENNA
intro.text: “Seeds. It takes three years to flower. After that it flowers every year, if it likes you.”

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: She labels her own gloves *left* and *right*. This packet says *3 years* and nothing else.

intro.speaker: SENNA
intro.text: “I kept a packet for myself. That’s not relevant.”

options.labelText: “Three years? Have you got anything faster? I’m terrible at waiting.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She takes the packet back and tucks it into the pocket labeled *later*.

options.labelText: “How do I keep it alive for three years? Start from the beginning.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She talks for a long time. Frost. Slugs. Which slugs are friends. How to apologize to an overwatered seedling.

branch.speaker: SENNA
branch.text: “Year three is mostly waiting. I’ll check on it. On you. On it.”
